description: Internal data structures, macros, and function declarations for managing references within the 'refs' module of a version control system, likely Git. It includes definitions for reference updates, transactions, iterators, and backend interfaces.

methods.name: get_files_ref_lock_timeout_ms
methods.description: Returns the timeout duration in milliseconds for retrying to acquire a loose reference lock.

methods.name: refname_is_safe
methods.description: Checks if a reference name is minimally safe for deletion without causing damage.

methods.name: ref_resolves_to_object
methods.description: Helper to verify if a reference name with a specific object ID can be resolved in the database.

methods.name: refs_read_raw_ref
methods.description: Reads raw reference data from a reference store.

methods.name: ref_transaction_maybe_set_rejected
methods.description: Marks a reference update as rejected with a specific error.

methods.name: ref_transaction_add_update
methods.description: Adds a reference update to a transaction with specified properties.

methods.name: parse_loose_ref_contents
methods.description: Parses the contents of a loose reference file.

methods.name: base_ref_store_init
methods.description: Initializes the base part of a reference store.

methods.name: maybe_debug_wrap_ref_store
methods.description: Wraps a reference store for debugging if needed.

methods.name: ref_update_original_update_refname
methods.description: Returns the original reference name under which an update was requested.

methods.name: ref_update_has_null_new_value
methods.description: Checks if the new value in a ref_update is null, considering symbolic references.

methods.name: ref_update_check_old_target
methods.description: Verifies if the old target value matches the current symbolic reference value.

methods.name: ref_update_expects_existing_old_ref
methods.description: Checks if the reference is expected to exist based on old_oid or old_target.

methods.name: refs_verify_refnames_available
methods.description: Verifies that a list of reference names are available for use, considering existing references and transaction state.
